instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete liquid-glass billing & inventory application tailored for Auro Products (contractor taking Tamil Nadu wine shop cotton box tender).

Core Feature 1: 149 TASMAC Wine Shops Directory with Shop No (e.g., Shop #1001 to #1149), District/Location (Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Salem, Trichy, Tanjore, etc.), Supervisor Name, Contact, Cycle Days (default 5 days or 2 days).
Core Feature 2: Delivery Reminders Dashboard - calculates next pickup date based on last entry date + shop cycle days. Highlight shops due today or overdue with pulsing alert badges.
Core Feature 3: Inventory Entry - Enter shop number, cotton box unit pcs (e.g. 2500 pcs). Auto-calculate Waste in kg using formula (Quantity / 12 kg). E.g. 2500 pcs / 12 = 208.33 kg waste.

Core Feature 4: GST Billing Invoice Generator - Generates official Tamil Nadu Tax Invoice for Auro Products with 18% GST (9% CGST + 9% SGST). Includes HSN 4819, Taxable Amount, CGST 9%, SGST 9%, Total Invoice Value, Rounding, Bank Account details, Terms, QR code, Triplicate copy tag.
Core Feature 5: Invoice PDF / Print view matching standard Indian GST invoice layout (clean black-and-white print output format with border grids, signature line, tax breakdown table).
Core Feature 6: Searchable & Paginated Tables across All Shops, Invoices, Box Entries, with Calendar/Date range filters and CSV export.

Core Feature 7: Liquid Glass UI theme with frosted transparent glass cards (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/65 border border-white/10 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-950/20), neon cyan/emerald active indicators, and sleek sidebar.
Core Feature 8: Settings Page - Allow editing company name (Auro Products), GSTIN, Tax Rates, Default Rate per Box / per KG, and tender reference numbers.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, modals, table cells, and summary counters have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes for testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered white cards or flat default themes. Use frosted liquid glass layering with cyan highlights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_and_padding: Containers with borders MUST have generous padding (p-6/p-8) to avoid text collision.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.button_styling: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl glass buttons with glow interactions and active transform states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: All key elements must have descriptive data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use sonner for user action confirmations (e.g., 'Invoice created', 'Inventory entry saved').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Never use emoji characters as icons. Use Lucide React icons.
